dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Dak Prescott Powers Cowboys Offense in Explosive 51-30 Win Over Titans
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Dallas improved to 5-6 following an explosive 51-30 victory over Tennessee behind Dak Prescott's four touchdown passes, keeping their NFC playoff hopes alive despite defensive vulnerabilities. The Cowboys now prepare to host the 3-7 Philadelphia Eagles in a crucial Week 12 divisional matchup.
bullets: Dak Prescott produced a dominant performance, completing 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards, four touchdowns, and one rushing score without an interception, as reported by [Todd Archer](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50566873/dak-prescott-continues-hot-streak-leads-cowboys-titans).

Wide receivers CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens both surpassed 100 receiving yards, helping Head Coach Brian Schottenheimer and Offensive Coordinator Klayton Adams direct a 51-point performance highlighted by [dallascowboys.com Official](https://www.dallascowboys.com/news/george-pickens-joins-ceedee-lamb-in-topping-100-yards).

Dallas achieved an 83.3% dropback success rate (30 successful gains on 36 dropbacks), the highest single-game mark in the NFL since Week 3 of 2023, per NextGenStats analysis from [Nate Tice](https://bsky.app/profile/natetice.bsky.social/post/3n2wk7n7wik2b).

Despite scoring 30.6 points per game (4th in NFL), Christian Parker's defense remains vulnerable heading into Week 12, ranking 32nd overall in yards allowed (393.8) and rushing defense (154.1), per [dallascowboys.com Official](https://www.dallascowboys.com/news/game-recap-offense-dominates-in-51-30-win).
